notes.title: Patch 1.1 The BUG CRUSHER
notes.content:
Welcome to our first major patch since Chrono Weaver's release! In this patch we really focused on creating stability in the puzzles and eliminating the moments where you lost because of bugs or issues with the game itself. Hopefully all your failures from here on out are truly just skill issues :) 

Shoutout to the players on our discord who helped us find these issues and were incredibly patient with us getting these fixes out.

We rebuilt ropes from the ceiling down, along with fixing trains randomly breaking, wheels not turning, and many more inconsistencies. Out main hope with 1.1 is to make you feel confident that when you are playing a puzzle your clone will do what you did 99% of the time.

We also added a new puzzle right after you get your first augment to help you understand how to "Think with Time Travel." Hopefully this new puzzle helps to ease the transition into the full game after you have beaten the content from the demo.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42662600/b1c3b55440c98fab8be13585164fac10ed9cbeab.png[/img]

As always we would love to hear from you in our Discord if you have questions, comments, found bugs, or just wanna hangout!

[h2]Full Patch Notes for 1.1.0[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a couple of hidden triggers that could block teleportation or the ball
[*] Fixed being able to hold objects through the end of a timeline
[*] Bouncers no longer freeze in place if the train they are attached to crashes
[*] Fixed many objects that just didn't do anything when replaying a puzzle that you had already beat
[*] Ropes have been completely rebuilt and now should behave much more like ropes
[*] Objects attached to ropes should now move consistently across timelines
[*] If you place the augment in your left hand it will now be correctly positioned
[*] Augments that fall off your hand will now snap back to your hand if not held within 5 seconds
[*] Added a new level after you get the augment to help teach you how to "Think with Time Travel"
[*] Added a tutorial to teach the first augment
[*] Updated an issue with the ending trigger of some puzzles causing you to skip the puzzle if you restarted the game while in the middle of a puzzle
[*] Train now correctly recovers if it was destroyed and you destroyed the data disk
[*] Trains no longer randomly break while just driving down the track, they actually have to hit something or fall over
[*] Transit Station has had the stairs adjusted so the train can no longer run into them
[*] Augment no longer pushes you if you hold it too close to your body
[*] Lever on the time machine no longer randomly stops being able to be pulled or pushed if you restart a puzzle too many times
[*] No longer have to switch from Smooth Loco to teleport to beat Garbage Disposal
[*] The arrows on the engine block of the train correctly scale with speed
[*] You timeline clones should no longer randomly disappear while you are playing
[*] You should no longer spawn after your clone has completed actions that you need to respawn to in early levels
[*] Added an iron grip when holding batteries in puzzles and they should now be VURTUE-ally impossible for your clones to drop.
[*] Hands should no longer freeze in place while changing physics scene
[*] Should no longer randomly teleport to the start of the puzzle when you get close to the start of the level
[*] Time Machine shouldn't be in the wrong state after exiting and then re-entering the bubble
[*] Large doors should now correctly animate open after the first timeline
[*] And many more small bugs and fixes that we forgot to take note of
[*] Shields shouldn't randomly fall out of your hands if you are flick turning in the open. They can still fall out if you hit something while turning.
[/list]

notes.title: Bring on the Batteries! Demo Updated to v3.0! 5 BRAND NEW PUZZLES!
notes.content:
[h1]Demo 3.0[/h1]

We have updated the demo to 3.0! This is a huge patch and bring parity between the full game release and the demo itself. We listened to a bunch of feedback and changed a bunch of things to improve player experience. We are hoping that if you tried the demo before and found the levels to get boring and repetitive or if you hated pulling the lever over and over again you will enjoy this version of the demo significantly more.

[h2]Creating Better Puzzle Sightlines[/h2]

After watching a number of play-throughs and talking to testers we decided to shuffle around the locations of the buttons in the first many levels to make it easier for you to watch your past self complete the actions needed to gain access to the data disk. This should make it easier to understand how time-travel is working and just more aesthetically pleasing. On a bonus we didn't predict it also opens up the levels in a way that makes them feel more engaging.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42662600/48a08ab8206d8bf258ce4a14483cbc8ba52d2882.png[/img]

[h2]Adding Physics Objects to Puzzles[/h2]

Something we wanted to add to the game for a long while but hadn't gotten around to yet was physics objects you could use after you fired the ball in a timeline. This requires a lot more work by your time-travelling clones, but after a lot of play-testing and bug hunting we got it so your clones can pick up, force pull, and slingshot physics objects.

The first way you will use this in Chrono Weaver is by interacting with removable batteries. These create a new factor in puzzles because you have to figure out how to get power to the right objects at the right time. If there is only 1 battery but 2 doors, how do you walk through both of them?

These removable batteries add a whole new side to the game and allowed us to remake the last 5 puzzles of the demo. We hope you enjoy them!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42662600/497b8526e6787764d73688d71d7640138ff4a6df.png[/img]


[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Re-arranged some of the early puzzles to update Line of Sight to make it easier to see your clone do tasks.
[*] Re-built all levels after the Offices to use Removable Batteries
[*] These should provide a new fun experience that creates diversity in the types of puzzles that you are solving and lets you play more with physics
[*] Puzzle walls are how HLODs to improve performance
[*] Ball Spawner now has VFX For spawning the ball
[*] Rebuilt how the time manager controls time-travel to be more performant
[*] Fixed a lot of bugs around the replaying of actions and things ending up in places that they shouldn't
[*] Enabled the ability for your clone to catch, force-pull, and slingshot physics objects inside of a timeline
[*] Adjusted lighting in some exploration sections to better match the theme of the game
[*] Individual disk pieces now have a rotation to make them easier to see from the side
[*] Added an EXPERT MODE to the settings menu that completely removes lever pulling if using the flip menu and hides the rewind
[*] Fixed a crazy amount of bugs
[/list]

[h1]Introducing Chrono Weaver Demo v2.1.0
[/h1]

In this update we added some sweet VFX for bounce multipliers. Now you can see how many bonus points you are going to get. And if you get a really high score on a level angels will sing! We also moved the flip menu tutorial to the introduction to timeloop so that you can use it during the first 5 levels of the game. This should improve your experience through the start of the game considerably. We also fixed a bunch of bugs around holding things in your hand, as well as other small bugs in a lot of places.

[h2]Full List of Changes:[/h2]

- Hands on Oculus Grab Markers better
- Grabbing of physics objects significantly improved. Especially the left hand.
- The Timeline tutorial now includes teaching the Flip Menu.
- Yoto explains more about the puzzles, including circuits and reminding the player about the flip menu
- TIM now only requires 1 lever pull and 1 lever push between timelines.
- Goal holders should now turn off when the goal isn't moving.
- Circuits now flash blue when on and are red when off.
- Removed some doors that were only 6ft high. Sorry tall people!
- Added a flip menu tutorial in the main menu for people in strange level completion states.
- Added the ribbon effect to the tutorial and target practice balls
- Added VFX for bounce scores
- Added new SFX for getting highscores on puzzles. Can you make the angels sing?
- Added a visual display for the tutorial to help people who miss what Yoto is saying
- Improved functionality of the flip menu to remove accidental uses
- Improved some visuals around the flip menu
- Fixed bugs with TIM spawning at the wrong height
- Fixed bugs with you not teleporting to TIM when transfering between timelines
- Fixed bugs relating to levels not loading correctly

notes.title: We Listened to You! Introducing Our Revamped Demo v2.0.
notes.content:
[h2]Tl;dr  Our Demo got WAY Better! Thanks for all your feedback![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42662600/e0a02ae64837810765185286c5c19346c66994df.gif[/img]

When we originally released this demo during VR fest back in December we had high hopes. However, after receiving a good bit of feedback on our discord we learned that [b]we missed the mark on our first release[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42662600/8fca28da96e79b9c331c2613eff0faa1ea3f5a1c.gif[/img]

Luckily, we are flexible and willing to change! So, we took a long honest look at the state of the demo, and we updated the heck out of it!

[h3]Introducing v2.0, The re-invention of the demo that we are so excited to have you try.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42662600/f13f7be48e0f8fce9e6f05499dd4d3e6b60ef874.gif[/img]

[b]We learned that there were three main places where the demo wasn’t up to our standards.[/b]
[list][*][b]Time to Fun[/b] - The amount of time it took for our players to get into the core puzzles of the game.[*][b]Agency[/b] - Players felt that the decisions they made during puzzles, especially before time-traveling, were underwhelming and not important.[*][b]Visual Clarity[/b] - Often it wasn’t clear inside of a puzzle what was going on.[/*][/list]
We went through every map and piece of dialog in the demo and cut, spliced, and updated it to something that we now feel is up to our standards. We are so hype to have everyone try the new version of our demo. It feels like a new game! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42662600/ecf32973e984b9bcf14da2c65baa652cd765bfcf.png[/img]
[i]Look how much more fun this map looks![/i]

As always, if you want to be a part of our development progress feel free to stop in to our discord and let us know what you thought of the demo! We would love to hear from you.

[url=https://discord.com/invite/vCwccjT6Te][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42662600/37e91d6a92d33e0a8f4b9acd2e645a3d35f222c7.png[/img][/url]

[i]Because of the size of this update all player saves have been deleted and you will have to start the demo over if you already had progressed through it. But with all the changes that have happened it is basically a brand new experience so we think you will enjoy it.[/i]

[h2]Highlights:[/h2]
[list][*]Reworked the introductory story and tutorial to be snappier and easier to get through, so you get to the puzzles faster.[*]Updated the Visuals to allow for more clarity in the puzzles.[*]Re-worked all of the puzzles to create more interesting decisions for the player.[*]Fixed a lot of bugs that stopped the player in their tracks. (if you continue to find new ones please reach out on our Discord!)[/*][/list]

[h2]Full Change-log:[/h2]

[h3]Updates:[/h3]
[list][*]Updated the Introductory story and tutorial to be snappier and faster to get through.[*]Re-ordered the maps to get the player into puzzles sooner.[*]Updated / changed [b]every single puzzle[/b] to create more interesting decisions for the player in the first timeline.[*]Introduced the idea of generators, switches, and wall wires to make it clear what buttons are doing when you press them.[/*] [*]Added Physical Sounds to most things in the game! Try throwing things against the wall! It’s so fun![*]Updated the visuals of the Lava and the clocks so they reflect better[*]Changed the color of Keycard interactables to make them easier to find in the level.[*]Smooth Loco now has a faster base speed and a curved variable speed.[*]Smooth turning now has togglable variable speed[*]Added the version to the menu so you can confirm that you successfully updated the game.[*]Added more masks to the game for the player to try on.[*]Updated windows to look and perform waaay better.[*]Revamped time-travel VFX so it is clearer to the player what is going on.[*]Updated a lot of locations that had aliasing on lower quality headsets.[*]Added more objects to the explosion VFX.[/*][/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]

[list][*]Made it so if the player falls through the main menu they teleport back to the menu automatically[*]Fixed spacing of meshes where you could see through the world[*]Fixed many lighting bugs throughout the world[*]Fixed your hand getting stuck in a closed fist when you just barely failed to grab something.[*]Fixed levers sometimes being sideways in the end-of puzzle scoreboards[*]Fixed an insane number of bugs related to teleporting around timelines while going back in time[*]Updated a number of meshes so that interacting with / moving around the world feels better.[*]Fixed a lot of bugs with the physics hands not being the correct position.[/*][/list]

notes.title: We Changed the Core Mechanic!
notes.content:
Hello Community!

Cooper here, one of the developers working on Chrono Weaver, and we thought it was about time to provide an update. We are still hard at work on this time-traveling physics puzzle game and are getting closer to a release! We know that good VR content is hard to come by these days and are hoping to help fill that void.

Before we get started, be sure to wishlist and follow Chrono Weaver!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2053370

This announcement is meant to give a general overview. In the coming weeks and months, we will post more of these updates going in depth into some of the items discussed below.

[h2]The release is getting closer![/h2]

We have built all the puzzles into the game and they are looking and playing great! Finding a balance between fun, exciting, and puzzling is not the easiest thing to do, especially as someone who likes really challenging puzzles, but we think we have struck a good balance. We're also getting positive feedback from play-testers on the quality of puzzles and are excited to branch out.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42662600/209253542aa903e836812c96db722fe1d7df347b.png[/img]

The story elements of the game have been mostly built out, and we are currently working on  voice acting and scripting out the in-game behaviors of the characters you will get to interact with. 

It is a fun change of pace to be working on story elements and not just playing puzzles 24/7, and it is kinda spooky realizing how little we have left to complete! We’re not used to the todo list actually getting smaller since usually every time you take one thing off you add 3 more on, and it is exciting seeing it move in the other direction.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42662600/0bb87d1bb2535908327e258d23a411514ba17d03.png[/img]

[h2]We made a big pivot to our core mechanic...[/h2]

You always hear from game devs how you have to be willing to pivot when things aren’t working out. And we definitely learned that lesson. Originally in Chrono Weaver, the player threw the ball to move through time and destroy the disk. This was a really fun use of VR, and if the throwing worked for you, it was amazing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42662600/f1a3d479f3085f369719de3c50887a72dff7b1c6.png[/img]

But too many players had issues with the throwing mechanic. Long story short, there are infinite ways of trying to throw the ball, and adjusting the values to be good for one person would break them for another.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42662600/8eba798206793f3bea1132bb6d9aa8d11f6445de.png[/img]

We looked at a lot of throwing data in detail and tried making the mechanics variable per person and letting people customize, but even then we had issues that we couldn’t even predict when we would test the game with a new player.

Finally we decided that maybe we should get rid of throwing and try something that is more consistent. The slingshot ended up being a great replacement: it still uses core VR mechanics and it is more predictable from player to player. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42662600/3da82433896eb8ee0ca2fa061916f2a7fd56b775.png[/img]

So far play-testing with the slingshot is not only more consistent but also more fun. We were nervous about pivoting, but now we are really happy that we did it.

[h2]Time-travel is hard to teach[/h2]

We learned through our play-testing that even when a player sees themselves doing something they did in a previous timeline, it isn’t immediately clear to them that they went back in time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42662600/4ff39c312cc535a903876ce192a40458a4fcce46.png[/img]

It is even less clear that they are supposed to predict what they are going to need to do back in time while doing things in the future. And if you think that sentence was confusing try explaining it in game to a player. 

We think we are finally getting to a point where our play-testers are starting to understand how to use time as one of the tools in their arsenal for solving puzzles. One of the biggest things we figured out was to add more and more and more simple levels that allow the player to prove and improve their knowledge. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42662600/de69fb9fc1e848d5145fdd958c2235aae362e2ce.png[/img]

Simple levels like this are really key because players that have figured it out will cruise through them and feel great, and players that are still struggling will have additional help to learn before getting to the more complicated sections of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42662600/65885e123a7ab9f568bff59b48956075a7fee005.png[/img]

[h2]More coming soon![/h2]

We are excited as we get closer to release to write more of these updates keeping y'all knowledgeable as to what is happening. This release has been a long time coming and we can’t wait for everyone to play the game.

[url=https://discord.com/invite/vCwccjT6Te][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42662600/2def9c5aef5838199ae0e5c038170538a440ebb8.png[/img][/url]

And make sure to wishlist Chrono Weaver to show your support and be notified of any updates and the release!
